# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository-wide working agreements.

Treat [SPEC.md](../SPEC.md) and applicable files under [specs/](../specs/) as
authoritative product requirements. Follow
[docs/development/coding-conventions.md](../docs/development/coding-conventions.md)
for detailed engineering conventions and the applicable files under
[.github/instructions/](instructions/) for path-specific guidance.

Do not duplicate or override those sources here. When a requested change needs
a new product or architectural decision, update the appropriate specification
or add an ADR instead of choosing silently.

The repository is in bootstrap. Do not claim build, format, lint, or test
commands exist until they are added and documented.
